description: Header file defining the DirectSharedImageVideoProvider class and related classes for managing shared image video resources on Android within Chromium's media GPU component.

classes.name: DirectSharedImageVideoProvider
classes.description: Implements SharedImageVideoProvider, manages shared image video resources, and operates on the thread it was created on, switching to GPU thread for resource creation.

classes.name: GpuSharedImageVideoFactory
classes.description: Creates SharedImageVideo objects, must run on GPU main thread, manages creation and destruction of shared images.

methods.name: DirectSharedImageVideoProvider
methods.description: Constructor initializing the provider with GPU task runner, stub callback, and lock.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the provider with a GPU stub callback.

methods.name: RequestImage
methods.description: Requests an image with specified parameters, providing a callback upon readiness.

methods.name: GpuSharedImageVideoFactory
methods.description: Constructor for the factory, takes a stub callback.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the factory with a GPU initialization callback.

methods.name: CreateImage
methods.description: Creates a shared image for given specifications and provides it via callback.

methods.name: CreateImageInternal
methods.description: Internal method to create shared image for a mailbox and image.

methods.name: OnWillDestroyStub
methods.description: Handles cleanup when the stub is destroyed.
